sheets.name: run_1
sheets.action: running (his move loop): a light, quick run, hunched forward, the sword held up behind him, the LEGS CHANGING OVER
sheets.weapons: THE SWORD goes where the pale figure has it, frame by frame (image 3 shows it in colour): ONE long sword with a BRIGHT GREEN blade, WHOLE and STRAIGHT, as long as in image 1, in his hands - raised behind him, swung, swept low or held upright as the pale figure holds it; where the pale figure has dropped it, lying on the ground. Never a second sword. Only the sword: no sword trails, no afterimages, no clones; the green glow stays inside the lenses.
sheets.legs: Frame 1: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the NEAR leg (the lighter one) planted straight down under his hips, its foot flat on the ground; the FAR leg (the darker one) kicked up and back behind him, bent, its foot high off the ground. Frame 2: SUPPORT ON THE NEAR LEG: the near leg still planted under his hips, bending; the far leg swinging down from behind, its foot off the ground behind the planted one. The two legs TAKE TURNS: in frames 1-4 the NEAR leg (the lighter one) carries him and the FAR leg comes forward, in frames 5-8 the FAR leg (the darker one) carries him and the NEAR leg comes forward - frames 1 and 5 must look different: a different leg planted, the other one kicked back. Never the same leg in front in every frame (Senna's first run did that, and Talon's: 「走路没有换腿」).
